title: Integrate Faster Whisper as the Speech-to-Text adapter
body:
Implement a Speech-to-Text adapter backed by Faster Whisper, running locally per ADR-002 (privacy, cost, latency).

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Adapter implements Core's Speech-to-Text interface
- Accepts a raw audio segment and returns transcribed text
- Model size/device configurable

title: Implement live per-speaker transcription
body:
Feed each participant's voice-activity segments into the Speech-to-Text adapter as they occur, instead of waiting for the whole session to end.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Transcription happens incrementally, segment by segment
- Raises a TranscriptReceived event per transcribed segment, tagged with the speaking participant

title: Persist the session transcript
body:
Store the full, ordered transcript of a session — text, timestamp and speaker — through the Database interface.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Transcript entries are queryable by session
- Entries preserve chronological order across overlapping speakers

title: Validate Portuguese-language transcription accuracy
body:
Portuguese is the primary language for the target audience (see PRODUCT.md). Validate Faster Whisper's accuracy on real RPG session audio and tune model/parameters accordingly.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- A sample of real or simulated RPG audio in Portuguese is transcribed and manually reviewed
- Model size/parameters documented as the recommended default
